critical_code_review_comments: DriverOnboarding.js debounced auto-save useEffect (~line 185) correctly triggers saveDraft() 1.5s after fullName + (email|phone) are entered — this is the fix that makes incomplete capture reliable. Backend POST /api/drivers with is_draft:true upserts by user_id (idempotent) so repeated auto-saves are safe.

AdminPanel.js Users tab now sets filteredUsers = users (trusts server ?q= filter). Search input data-testid=admin-users-search-input is wired to setSearchQuery and backend GET /api/admin/users?q= returns matches by name/email/phone — verified working.
IncompleteApplications.js card renders enriched name/email/phone from linked user account — verified populated (not blank).

context_for_next_testing_agent: The debounced auto-save on step 1 of /driver-onboarding is the critical behavior. Verify by filling full-name-input, email-input, phone-input and waiting >2s WITHOUT clicking Next, then GET /api/drivers/me (as that customer) should return a driver record with status='incomplete'. Admin -> Users tab search hits GET /api/admin/users?q= and trusts server results.
rca of the issue: Prior bug root cause was that draft was only persisted on 'Next' click. Current implementation adds a debounced useEffect ([formData.fullName, formData.email, formData.phone] deps, 1500ms) that calls saveDraft() -> POST /api/drivers {is_draft:true}. Backend upserts by user_id so repeated calls are idempotent. Verified end-to-end: applicant now appears in admin Incomplete Applications card AND in Users Management table even though 'Next' was never clicked.
